title: Canonical derived section-module realization
statement: Use the localized section equivalence, derived functors, conjugate K-flat tensor and unit, signed direct-sum total and localized ordinary total comparison of [def-pd-section-derived-tensor-data]. Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring] and use the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] with ordinary operations of [def-pd-proetale-section-module-functors]. The localization comparison $q$ for the conjugate derived tensor is uniquely specified on every pair of termwise section-equivalence images by the ordinary total comparison and the internal localization tensor map [sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom], [def-sfb-modobj-relative-tensor]. It is invertible if either factor is K-flat [pur713-def-kflat-module], [def-pc-kflat-complex], and its unit is the regular section-ring module in degree zero. Define the tensor-pullback isomorphism by its unique representative square with this $q$, the ordinary oplax mate and exact localization factors, namely the canonical ringed tensor comparison [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback]. Define the comparisons of the internal total derived operations [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull] with the ringed functors by localization of the ordinary pullback comparison and canonical K-injective derived-composition isomorphisms. Derive the specified ordinary ringed module adjunction canonically using K-flat and K-injective resolutions, and express its left adjoint by exact termwise localization through the canonical left-derived comparison. This ringed derived adjunction is specified independently of transport of the internal derived adjunction; their compatibility is the comparison theorem to be stated. For an open immersion, localize the fixed ordinary extension, its mate-normalized equivalence comparison and its open adjunction; sequential colimits of section-module sheaves are exact by the fixed exact equivalence. Express the internal derived open adjunction with right adjoint $Lj^*$. Define the derived pullback compositor by localizing the geometric ordinary compositor. Retain the original independent site universes and all unbounded complexes.
